title: Star Magic Sorceress
description: A full-body illustration of a young female character with teal hair and glowing green eyes, standing in a dynamic pose. She wears a dark blue and teal cropped mage outfit with star motifs, fingerless gloves, and boots, casting swirling turquoise magical energy with star particles from both hands.
prompt: A confident young female sorceress with short spiky teal hair, glowing green eyes, and facial markings stands in a wide stance casting magic. She wears a cropped dark blue and teal oriental-style top with a star belt, baggy teal pants, star-adorned boots, and a flowing dark cape with constellation patterns. Turquoise glowing energy with stars swirls around her hands and body, digital illustration, vibrant colors, dynamic pose, plain gray background
